{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Plastic''', or '''cast-plast''' was a term used to describe synthetic or semi-synthetic solid material used in the manufacture of industrial products. The [[U2-C1-series housekeeping droid]]'s frame was made from hardened plastic.<ref name="TGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[Slugthrower/Legends|Slugthrower]] [[Slug/Legends|ammunition]] could be made from hardened plastics.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
